catatan: Cocok: jumlah pandangan optimal (dua, empat, enam) bergantung pada intensitas pemangkasan; pemangkasan lebih berat memerlukan lebih sedikit pandangan.

bagian: Acquisition: how many views, and from where
kalimat: Discrete views taken around a tree, as in SawitMVC [indriani2026sawitmvc] or the eight-sided mango protocol of [nenavath2024tree], have wide baselines and no temporal order, so M3 does not apply and association must rely on appearance, geometry, or learning.
bukti: each photographed from four sides at 90-degree intervals or eight sides at 45-degree intervals
catatan: Pandangan diskret mengelilingi pohon didukung abstrak. Pernyataan baseline lebar dan tanpa urutan temporal adalah simpulan tinjauan dari interval 45-90 derajat.

bagian: Acquisition: how many views, and from where
kalimat: Discrete views taken around a tree, as in SawitMVC [indriani2026sawitmvc] or the eight-sided mango protocol of [nenavath2024tree], have wide baselines and no temporal order, so M3 does not apply and association must rely on appearance, geometry, or learning.
bukti: in this research, we split a video into frames to obtain eight-sided images; thus, the total frames were divided by eight, and then eight were obtained. Then, the frame in the east is the first frame
perbaikan: Qualify the mango example: "...or the eight-sided mango protocol of [nenavath2024tree], in which eight frames are sampled at equal intervals from a clockwise walk-around video, ...". The eight retained views are widely separated, but they come from an ordered video sequence, so state that M3 does not apply to the retained frames rather than that the acquisition has no temporal order.
catatan: Protokol delapan sisi dan mangga cocok. Namun delapan citra bukan foto lepas: citra diambil dari video 360 derajat searah jarum jam (45-75 s, sekitar 30 fps) yang dipecah menjadi frame, lalu dipilih delapan frame berurutan arah. Pernyataan 'no temporal order' tidak tepat untuk kajian ini; hitungan ganda dihindari dengan mengurangi 'corner mango' (Pers. 5), bukan dengan asosiasi.

bagian: Acquisition: how many views, and from where
kalimat: Several groups have treated view selection itself as the problem: active view planning for apple clusters [roy2017active], viewpoint planning with an octree of fruit regions [zaenker2021viewpoint], and graph-based view sequences for sweet pepper [zaenker2023graph].
bukti: We focus on the subtask of planning views so as to accurately estimate the number of apples in an apple cluster.
catatan: Abstrak menyatakan perencanaan pandang aktif untuk klaster apel; sesuai.

bagian: Acquisition: how many views, and from where
kalimat: Several groups have treated view selection itself as the problem: active view planning for apple clusters [roy2017active], viewpoint planning with an octree of fruit regions [zaenker2021viewpoint], and graph-based view sequences for sweet pepper [zaenker2023graph].
bukti: We present a novel viewpoint planning approach that builds up an octree of plants with labeled regions of interest (ROIs), i.e., fruits. Our method uses this octree to sample viewpoint candidates
catatan: Perencanaan sudut pandang dengan octree berlabel ROI buah sesuai sumber; tanaman uji adalah paprika (capsicum).

bagian: Acquisition: how many views, and from where
kalimat: Several groups have treated view selection itself as the problem: active view planning for apple clusters [roy2017active], viewpoint planning with an octree of fruit regions [zaenker2021viewpoint], and graph-based view sequences for sweet pepper [zaenker2023graph].
bukti: we propose a novel view motion planner that builds a graph network of viable view poses and trajectories between nearby poses [...] The planner searches the graphs for view sequences with the highest accumulated information gain, allowing for efficient pepper plant monitoring
catatan: Abstrak menyebut graf pose pandang, urutan pandang, dan tanaman sweet pepper.

kalimat: Nuske et al. registered images from a vehicle driving along vineyard rows and related berry counts to harvest yield; with calibration data from a prior harvest the estimate was within 4%, and within 3% with destructive samples taken at the time of imaging [nuske2014modeling].
bukti: We find that it is possible to estimate yield to within 4% using calibration data from prior harvest data and 3% using calibration data from destructive hand samples at the time of imaging.
catatan: Angka 4% dan 3% sesuai. Registrasi dilakukan dengan visual odometry dan deteksi tiang, lalu citra dipotong agar tidak terjadi hitung ganda (h. 9).

kalimat: Across four seasons their estimates captured up to 75% of the spatial variance in yield [nuske2014automated].
bukti: Our experimentation is conducted over four growing seasons in several wine and table-grape vineyards. [...] yield estimates that capture up to 75% of spatial yield variance and with an average error between 3% and 11% of total yield.
catatan: Empat musim tanam dan 75% varians spasial hasil panen sesuai dengan abstrak.

kalimat: Linker photographed 42 apple trees from two sides at three heights, summed the six counts per tree, and calibrated the sum against 14 trees; the orchard estimate was within 10% of the actual yield although single-tree errors were sometimes large [linker2015estimation].
bukti: Forty two trees were photographed from two sides with cameras mounted at three heights. [...] Although the yield estimate error for a single tree was sometimes large, the overall yield estimate was within 10% of the actual yield.
catatan: Semua angka cocok (42 pohon, dua sisi, tiga ketinggian, enam citra, 14 pohon kalibrasi). Catatan: pada 10 ulangan subset kalibrasi, galat pohon validasi melebihi 10% satu kali per pendekatan (A10 -10,49%; B10 12,51%); galat seluruh pohon selalu di bawah 10%.

kalimat: Song et al. aggregated repeated, incomplete observations of pepper fruit in over 28,000 images of more than 1,000 plants with a statistical clustering step and reached a correlation of 74.2% with manual counts without linear adjustment [song2014automatic].
bukti: Our calibration and validation datasets each consist of over 28,000 colour images of over 1000 experimental plants. [...] our proposed method achieves a correlation of 74.2% without any linear adjustment for a large dataset.
catatan: Angka cocok. Catatan: lebih dari 28.000 citra itu berlaku untuk masing-masing set kalibrasi dan validasi, bukan jumlah keseluruhan.

kalimat: Stein et al. found the dual-view counts more tightly correlated with true counts than any other design, and Anderson et al. reported absolute errors of 2% or less in repeated night-time imaging of mango orchards [stein2016image, anderson2021estimation].
bukti: The dual-view method had the highest precision (R2 = 0.94), but was also inaccurate, counting 54% of the fruit (double the single-view count).
catatan: Cocok untuk bagian Stein dkk.: R2 dual 0,94 lebih tinggi daripada single 0,81 dan multi-view 0,90. Bagian Anderson dkk. tidak dinilai di sini.

kalimat: Stein et al. found the dual-view counts more tightly correlated with true counts than any other design, and Anderson et al. reported absolute errors of 2% or less in repeated night-time imaging of mango orchards [stein2016image, anderson2021estimation].
bukti: High repeatability was achieved in night-time imaging, with an absolute percentage error of 2% or less.
catatan: Angka 2% adalah keterulangan antarpengambilan citra malam (hitungan pukul 20.00 dan 21.30 sebesar 98% dan 102% dari hitungan pukul 21.00), bukan galat terhadap hitungan sebenarnya. Kata 'repeated' di naskah sudah menyiratkan hal itu; frasa 'repeatability error' akan lebih tegas.

kalimat: The factor describes an average tree, cannot say which fruit was counted twice, and must be refitted when canopy, cultivar, or acquisition changes; Anderson et al. found the error on trellised orchards (25.2%) to be several times that on hedge or single-leader systems (3.4–8.2%), and correcting multi-view counts with hand counts of a stratified sample increased the average error from 11% to 17% [anderson2021estimation].
halaman: Abstrak, h. 1; Sek. 4, h. 16; Tabel 2, h. 11-12
bukti: reasonable estimates achieved on hedge, single leader and conventional systems (3.4, 5.0, and 8.2 average percentage error, respectively) while fruit load of trellised orchards was over-estimated (at 25.2 average percentage error)
perbaikan: Anderson et al. found the error on trellised canopies (25.2%) to be several times that on hedge, single-leader, or conventional systems (3.4-8.2%), and in the 2019-2020 season, across the nine orchards with all methods, correcting multi-view counts with hand counts of a stratified sample increased the average error from 11% to 17%
catatan: Rentang 3,4-8,2% mencakup sistem konvensional (8,2%); hedge dan single leader saja adalah 3,4% dan 5,0%. Kenaikan 11% ke 17% hanya berlaku untuk sembilan kebun pada musim 2019-2020; pada musim 2020-2021 (enam kebun) koreksi menurunkan galat dari 23,5% ke 15,5% (tidak signifikan), sehingga kualifikasi musim diperlukan.

kalimat: Regression from partial views to total counts remains common in UAV work: Apolo-Apolo et al. related top-view apple counts to total counts per tree with R^2=0.80 [apoloapolo2020cloud], and Li et al. used a regression across three views to account for blueberries seen more than once [li2023blueberry].
halaman: Abstrak, h. 1; Hasil dan Gambar 9, h. 9
bukti: As only parts of the tree fruits were visible in the top-view images, linear regression was used to estimate the number of total apples on each tree. An R2 value of 0.80 (MAE: 128.56 and RMSE: 130.56) was obtained.
catatan: Apel, citra UAV pandangan atas, regresi linear ke jumlah buah dipanen per pohon, R2 0,80 (n = 19 pohon). Penulis sendiri menilai galatnya tinggi (MAE 128,56).

kalimat: Regression from partial views to total counts remains common in UAV work: Apolo-Apolo et al. related top-view apple counts to total counts per tree with R^2=0.80 [apoloapolo2020cloud], and Li et al. used a regression across three views to account for blueberries seen more than once [li2023blueberry].
bukti: captures images of blueberry plants from three distinct views (top, left, and right) [...] Accounting for the overlapping information from the three views, we employ a regression model to estimate the total number of blueberries per plant.
catatan: Tiga pandangan, regresi, dan tumpang-tindih antarpandangan sesuai abstrak. Platform adalah wahana darat bergerak multikamera, bukan UAV; kalimat naskah tidak menyatakan Li dkk. memakai UAV secara eksplisit, tetapi pembukanya ('common in UAV work') dapat menimbulkan kesan itu.

kalimat: Most studies follow tracking by detection: a detector finds fruit in each frame, a Kalman filter predicts where each track should appear next, and an assignment step, usually the Hungarian algorithm on overlap or distance, links detections to tracks [bewley2016simple, wojke2017simple, zhang2022bytetrack].
bukti: two classical yet extremely efficient methods, Kalman filter [14] and Hungarian method [15], are employed to handle the motion prediction and data association components of the tracking problem respectively.
catatan: SORT adalah kerangka tracking-by-detection; biaya penugasan berupa jarak IOU antara deteksi dan kotak prediksi, diselesaikan dengan algoritma Hungarian (h. 3). Kajian ini melacak pejalan kaki, bukan buah; kata 'fruit' adalah kerangka tinjauan.

kalimat: Most studies follow tracking by detection: a detector finds fruit in each frame, a Kalman filter predicts where each track should appear next, and an assignment step, usually the Hungarian algorithm on overlap or distance, links detections to tracks [bewley2016simple, wojke2017simple, zhang2022bytetrack].
bukti: A conventional way to solve the association between the predicted Kalman states and newly arrived measurements is to build an assignment problem that can be solved using the Hungarian algorithm.
catatan: Kalman filter kecepatan konstan dan penugasan Hungarian sesuai. Metrik asosiasi studi ini adalah jarak Mahalanobis digabung jarak kosinus penampilan (bukan hanya tumpang-tindih), yang tercakup oleh frasa 'usually ... overlap or distance'.

kalimat: Most studies follow tracking by detection: a detector finds fruit in each frame, a Kalman filter predicts where each track should appear next, and an assignment step, usually the Hungarian algorithm on overlap or distance, links detections to tracks [bewley2016simple, wojke2017simple, zhang2022bytetrack].
bukti: we adopt Kalman filter to predict the new locations in the current frame of each track in T [...] Then, we adopt Hungarian Algorithm [31] to finish the matching based on the similarity.
catatan: Paradigma tracking-by-detection, prediksi Kalman filter, dan penugasan Hungarian atas IoU atau jarak fitur Re-ID sesuai. Sumber ini kajian MOT umum (pejalan kaki), bukan buah; kalimat naskah memakainya sebagai rujukan metode.

kalimat: Parico et al. found the unique-ID rule more reliable for pears (F1 87.85%), because detection flicker caused the line rule to miss fruit that were detected [parico2021real]; Zhang et al. counted citrus only when a track entered a fixed region, and this rule gave the lowest error in Table (ref) [zhang2022deep].
bukti: the former was found to be more reliable compared to the ROI-line method in counting the pears, as characterized by its F1count of 87.85%. [...] due to flickering in detection it was not able to count some pears despite their being detected.
catatan: F1count 87,85% (ID unik) terhadap 72,94% (garis ROI) pada Tabel 9; alasan kedipan deteksi dinyatakan di abstrak dan simpulan.

kalimat: Parico et al. found the unique-ID rule more reliable for pears (F1 87.85%), because detection flicker caused the line rule to miss fruit that were detected [parico2021real]; Zhang et al. counted citrus only when a track entered a fixed region, and this rule gave the lowest error in Table (ref) [zhang2022deep].
bukti: [parafrasa web] Wilayah hitung pelacakan selebar 3/5 lebar bingkai di bagian tengah; 1/5 setelah posisi awal dan 1/5 sebelum posisi keluar adalah wilayah tidak sah. Dengan strategi ini MAE 0,081, terendah dibanding Sort 0,45 dan DeepSort 1,212.
catatan: Wilayah hitung tetap dan galat terendah di antara tiga pelacak dalam kajian ini sesuai. Kata 'only' tidak dapat dipastikan kata demi kata: Tabel 1 kajian memakai wilayah awal/keluar untuk sebagian kondisi oklusi. Klaim 'terendah di Tabel' naskah hanya diperiksa terhadap baris kajian ini.

kalimat: Two apple and citrus studies that compared trackers on the same data found that DeepSORT, which adds a learned appearance descriptor to the motion model, did not outperform trackers that use motion alone and cost far more computation (Table (ref)) [zhang2022deep, genemola2023video].
bukti: produced more accurate results than the existing standards Sort and DeepSort (MAE = 0.45 and 1.212; SD = 0.4741 and 1.3975)
perbaikan: Attribute only the accuracy result to Zhang et al.: DeepSORT had a higher counting error than motion-only SORT (MAE 1.212 vs 0.45). Zhang et al. report no runtime or computation comparison; cite the computational cost only to [genemola2023video].
catatan: Bagian 'DeepSORT tidak mengungguli pelacak gerak' didukung (1,212 vs 0,45 vs 0,081). Bagian 'cost far more computation' tidak dilaporkan kajian ini: halaman artikel tidak memuat FPS, waktu, atau biaya komputasi pelacak.

kalimat: Two apple and citrus studies that compared trackers on the same data found that DeepSORT, which adds a learned appearance descriptor to the motion model, did not outperform trackers that use motion alone and cost far more computation (Table (ref)) [zhang2022deep, genemola2023video].
halaman: Seksi III-A dan Tabel I, h. 3 (PDF UPCommons)
bukti: These outcomes suggest that the appearance features employed in the DeepSORT algorithm did not significantly contribute to improved fruit tracking performance.
catatan: Data apel. DeepSORT lebih rendah pada MOTA dan IDF1 serta 128,0 ms banding sekitar 15 ms. Catatan ketelitian: HOTA DeepSORT 0,6824 sedikit di atas SORT 0,6804 (selisih 0,002), tetapi di bawah ByteTrack 0,6894.

kalimat: Saraceni et al. designed AgriSORT to use motion only, arguing that fruit are static targets of similar appearance, and released a table-grape benchmark with strong self-similarity [saraceni2024agrisort].
bukti: we propose AgriSORT, a simple, online, real-time tracking-by-detection pipeline for precision agriculture based only on motion information [...] table grape vineyard, particularly challenging due to strong self-similarity and density of the instances.
catatan: Argumen target statis berpenampilan serupa ada di abstrak dan h. 2 ("all crops are visually similar and static"). Tolok ukur anggur meja: empat sekuens beranotasi (Tabel I, h. 3); kode dan data dinyatakan tersedia.

kalimat: Piazolo et al. improved SORT with a matching cascade over Mahalanobis, IoU, and Euclidean distances and reached accuracy comparable to DeepSORT without identity training data [piazolo2026enhanced].
bukti: SORT+ and DeepSORT+ incorporate a novel matching cascade that leverages the complementary strengths of Mahalanobis, IoU, and Euclidean distances. [...] making the training-free SORT+ comparable to the deep-learning-based DeepSORT.
catatan: Abstrak menyebut "comparable to DeepSORT" tanpa menyebut metrik; kata "accuracy" di naskah adalah penafsiran yang masih wajar.

kalimat: The same issue appears outside agriculture: DanceTrack was built because targets with uniform appearance and diverse motion defeat trackers that rely on appearance [sun2022dancetrack].
bukti: This trend in algorithmic development makes existing solutions fail catastrophically in situations where objects share very similar appearance, e.g., group dancing where performers wear uniform clothes.
catatan: Sesuai: dataset dibangun untuk kasus penampilan seragam dan gerak beragam; pelacak yang mengandalkan pencocokan penampilan turun kinerjanya.

kalimat: Studies that reported good results with DeepSORT exist, for example banana bunches with RGB-D and three constraints (96.82% counting success) [zhou2025yield], but they did not compare against a motion-only tracker on the same data.
halaman: Bagian 3.3 dan Gambar 8, h. 11; batasan di Bagian 2.4, h. 7
bukti: with an increase in the number of restrictions, the statistics steadily neared the actual value, and the average accuracy of each row gradually increased to 96.82%.
catatan: Pisang, RGB-D, DeepSORT, tiga batasan, dan 96,82% sesuai. Naskah sumber hanya membandingkan empat kondisi batasan pada DeepSORT; tidak ada pembanding pelacak lain. Angka 96,82% adalah rerata akurasi per baris dari enam baris (61 tandan).

kalimat: Missed detections break tracks and create new IDs; Zhang et al. added trajectory prediction to bridge such gaps in blueberry video [zhang2025robust], and Zhou et al. added a multiple-mapping step for occluded strawberries [zhou2024advancing].
bukti: we put forward a prediction-driven two-stage matching strategy based on ByteTrack, which effectively reduces duplicate counting caused by missed detections
catatan: Prediksi lintasan (enkoder KAN, dekoder Mamba) untuk melengkapi lintasan bluberi di rumah kaca; abstrak tidak memakai kata video secara eksplisit, tetapi pelacakan antarbingkai tersirat.

kalimat: Missed detections break tracks and create new IDs; Zhang et al. added trajectory prediction to bridge such gaps in blueberry video [zhang2025robust], and Zhou et al. added a multiple-mapping step for occluded strawberries [zhou2024advancing].
bukti: To strengthen its resilience against occlusion, we have enhanced the tracking-by-detection algorithms with a multiple mapping algorithm.
catatan: Langkah multiple mapping untuk stroberi yang teroklusi sesuai abstrak.

kalimat: Camera shake on a legged robot reduced tracking accuracy until camera-motion compensation added 2.9 points of MOTA [zhang2024stablesort], and low frame rates from UAVs motivated motion-direction costs and ORB-based compensation in PineSORT [xieli2025pinesort].
bukti: In ablation experiments, integrating the camera motion compensation module into the tracking algorithm improves MOTA by 2.9%.
catatan: Robot dog sesuai dengan legged robot; getaran kamera dinyatakan mengganggu pelacakan. Abstrak menulis 2,9% (MOTA akhir 63,4% pada nektarin), naskah menulis 2.9 points; tafsiran ini wajar tetapi abstrak tidak menegaskan satuan poin persentase.

kalimat: Camera shake on a legged robot reduced tracking accuracy until camera-motion compensation added 2.9 points of MOTA [zhang2024stablesort], and low frame rates from UAVs motivated motion-direction costs and ORB-based compensation in PineSORT [xieli2025pinesort].
bukti: Our approach tackles key challenges such as repetitive patterns, similar object appearances, low frame rates, and drone motion effects. PineSORT enhances the tracking accuracy with motion direction cost, camera motion compensation, a three-stage association strategy, and overlap management.
catatan: Abstrak juga menyebut kompensasi kamera berbasis ORB untuk perpindahan besar pada rekaman drone ber-FPS rendah (nanas). Laju bingkai rendah adalah salah satu dari beberapa tantangan yang disebut, bukan satu-satunya motivasi.

kalimat: Wang et al. measured the net effect in the most transparent way, by reporting double counts (9.9%) and misses (7.3%) separately instead of only their difference [wang2019mango].
bukti: Total repeat count [...] 19 [...] 9.9% [...] Missed count due to new fruit assigned to old fruit position [...] −14 [...] −7.3% [...] Estimated count 197 [...] 102.6%
catatan: Tabel 1 melaporkan hitung ganda dan hitung terlewat secara terpisah. Kalimat isi h. 14 menulis 9,7% dan 7,1%; naskah mengikuti Tabel 1 dan abstrak.

kalimat: Wang et al. listed it as a separate source of double counts [wang2019mango], and Liu et al. used the depth of each fruit relative to its tree trunk to drop fruit that belong to the far side [liu2019monocular].
bukti: Liu et al. [36] summarized three major issues causing over counting in video based fruit yield estimation [...] and (3) double count of fruit seen from both sides of a tree.
catatan: Dinilai dengan anggapan bahwa kata "it" merujuk hitung ganda buah yang terlihat dari dua sisi pohon. Wang dkk. mencantumkannya sebagai butir (3), tetapi daftar itu dinisbatkan kepada Liu dkk.; Wang dkk. juga menanganinya dengan ambang ukuran kotak (h. 11).

kalimat: Wang et al. listed it as a separate source of double counts [wang2019mango], and Liu et al. used the depth of each fruit relative to its tree trunk to drop fruit that belong to the far side [liu2019monocular].
halaman: Seksi IV, h. 3; Seksi IV-D, h. 5
bukti: These centroids are used as depth thresholds so only fruits that are closer to the camera than the tree centroids are counted, thus accounting for the third source of double count.
catatan: Sentroid pohon didekati dengan batang; buah di belakang batang tidak dihitung.

kalimat: Xia et al. matched patches of fruit between sequence images with a one-to-one assignment and reached F1 0.816 for apples and 0.864 for oranges in identifying repeated fruit [xia2022culling].
bukti: the fruit matching model obtained an F1-Score of 0.816 and 0.864 for both apple and orange, with good accuracy, precision, and recall.
catatan: Penugasan satu-ke-satu memakai algoritma Kuhn-Munkres; F1 diukur pada 20 kelompok pasangan citra bersebelahan per jenis buah.

kalimat: Kirk et al. used re-identification to count soft fruit through occlusions [kirk2021robust].
bukti: [parafrasa web] Abstrak di halaman Springer: jaringan dengan dua kepala, re-identification dan klasifikasi kematangan, menjaga konsistensi track; counting-by-tracking mencapai MAPE 3% (L1 = 7) dibanding 21% (L1 = 41) pada baseline pelacakan multiobjek.
catatan: Klaim bersifat kualitatif dan sesuai judul serta abstrak. Jenis buah spesifik tidak disebut di abstrak. Teks lengkap tidak terjangkau.

kalimat: Zheng et al. combined image appearance and position in a learned distance and clustered strawberry detections from overlapping UAV images; the result found fruit that an orthomosaic hid [zheng2023object].
bukti: an improved FaceNet model was proposed to combine the image and position information to calculate the feature distance between those objects, and a clustering algorithm was used to associate the cluster with each unique strawberry
perbaikan: Zheng et al. combined image appearance and position in a learned distance (an improved FaceNet) and clustered strawberry fruit and flower detections from overlapping multi-view remote sensing images; the result recovered objects that the orthomosaic hid (recognition accuracy of ripe fruit rose from 69.81% to 97.17%) [zheng2023object].
catatan: Jarak terpelajar, pengelompokan, dan objek yang tersembunyi di ortomosaik sesuai abstrak. Kata "UAV" tidak ada di abstrak (hanya "multi-view remote sensing images" dengan tumpang-tindih depan dan samping); wahana akuisisi belum terperiksa dari teks lengkap. Objek mencakup bunga, bukan hanya buah.

kalimat: The pattern across these studies is that appearance works when combined with position and fails as the only cue for look-alike fruit, which agrees with the tracker comparisons above and with the person re-identification literature, where discriminative identity features are learned from large sets of labelled identities [zheng2015scalable, ye2022deep].
bukti: This dataset contains 32,668 bboxes of 1,501 identities. [...] our dataset serves as an ideal benchmark for metric learning methods
perbaikan: Cite zheng2015scalable for the benchmark, not for feature learning: "... the person re-identification literature, which relies on large benchmarks of labelled identities such as Market-1501 (1,501 identities, 32,668 boxes) [zheng2015scalable] and learns discriminative identity features from them [ye2022deep]."
catatan: Kajian ini menyumbang himpunan data berlabel besar (Market-1501), tetapi metode yang diusulkannya adalah deskriptor Bag-of-Words tanpa supervisi; pembelajaran metrik hanya diuji sebagai tambahan (h. 7). Pernyataan bahwa fitur identitas diskriminatif dipelajari dari identitas berlabel tidak didukung langsung oleh kajian ini; pernyataan itu lebih tepat disandarkan pada ye2022deep.

kalimat: The pattern across these studies is that appearance works when combined with position and fails as the only cue for look-alike fruit, which agrees with the tracker comparisons above and with the person re-identification literature, where discriminative identity features are learned from large sets of labelled identities [zheng2015scalable, ye2022deep].
bukti: Training data annotation is usually indispensable for discriminative Re-ID model learning due to the large cross-camera variations. In the existence of large domain shift, we often need to annotate the training data in every new scenario.
catatan: Sumber menyatakan pembelajaran fitur diskriminatif Re-ID tertutup mengandaikan data latih beranotasi identitas yang cukup (h. 2-3). Sumber juga membahas Re-ID tanpa label atau berlabel terbatas sebagai latar terbuka; klaim naskah berlaku untuk latar tersupervisi.

kalimat: Wang et al. used a stereo rig at night on an autonomous vehicle and registered sequential images; block-level errors were -3.2% for about 480 red-apple trees and 1.2% for about 670 green-apple trees [wang2013automated].
bukti: The crop yield estimation errors are -3.2% for a red apple block with about 480 trees, and 1.2% for a green apple block with about 670 trees.
catatan: Rig stereo dua kamera, malam hari dengan pencahayaan buatan, kendaraan otonom, dan registrasi citra berurutan semuanya tertulis di abstrak.

kalimat: Stein et al. established pairwise correspondences between images from the trajectory of a navigation system, triangulated tracked fruit, and used LiDAR to assign each fruit to its tree; 522 trees and 71,609 mangoes were scanned and the error for individual trees was 1.36% [stein2016image].
bukti: A total of 522 trees and 71,609 mangoes were scanned [...] only the proposed multi-view approach can do so without calibration, with an error rate of only 1.36% for individual trees.
catatan: Semua unsur cocok dengan abstrak (korespondensi dari trajektori navigasi, triangulasi, masker LiDAR per pohon, 522 pohon, 71.609 mangga, 1,36%). Catatan: 1,36% berasal dari kemiringan regresi 1,0136 atas 16 pohon tervalidasi (h. 13 dan 19), yaitu bias agregat, bukan galat tiap pohon; 71.609 adalah jumlah setelah dikoreksi dengan kemiringan itu (h. 16).

kalimat: Liu et al. replaced the navigation and LiDAR suite with a monocular camera: fruit and trunks were tracked in 2D, converted into 3D landmarks by semantic structure from motion, and projected back into every image to detect double tracks [liu2019monocular, liu2018robust].
bukti: The third part projects those 3D landmarks back to the image plane of every image in order identify double tracks and address the second source of double count.
catatan: Hanya kamera monokular; pembanding memakai kamera, LiDAR, dan GPS/INS. Semantic SfM mengubah jejak 2D buah dan batang menjadi landmark 3D (abstrak, h. 1). Bagian yang diatribusikan ke liu2018robust tidak dinilai di sini.

kalimat: Liu et al. replaced the navigation and LiDAR suite with a monocular camera: fruit and trunks were tracked in 2D, converted into 3D landmarks by semantic structure from motion, and projected back into every image to detect double tracks [liu2019monocular, liu2018robust].
halaman: Abstrak, h. 1; Gambar 5, h. 5; Seksi IV, h. 6
bukti: After localizing these fruit tracks in 3D, we can easily detect these double counted fruits since they will be close in 3D space. In addition, we can remove fruit outliers in terms of size.
perbaikan: Cite only [liu2019monocular] for trunk tracking, semantic structure from motion and reprojection of landmarks into every image. For [liu2018robust] write: 'an earlier monocular pipeline tracked fruit in 2D and used structure from motion to localise the tracks in 3D, rejecting double-counted tracks by their 3D proximity and outliers by depth and relative size'.
catatan: Makalah 2018 memang memakai kamera monokular dan pelacakan buah 2D (FCN, KLT, Kalman, Hungarian) dengan koreksi SfM. Namun, batang tidak dilacak, istilah semantic SfM tidak dipakai, dan jejak ganda dideteksi dari kedekatan posisi 3D, bukan dari proyeksi balik landmark ke setiap citra. Rincian tersebut milik liu2019monocular.

kalimat: Roy et al. built a piecewise incremental SfM for apple rows because standard SfM failed under the constrained geometry of a row [roy2016surveying], then merged counts from both sides of 252 trees with an accuracy of 91.98–94.81% [roy2019vision].
bukti: The constrained geometry of the setup causes existing structure from motion algorithms to fail. We present a novel piecewise incremental structure from motion technique to register and reconstruct the apples
catatan: Bagian yang dinilai hanya SfM piecewise incremental dan alasan kegagalan SfM baku. Abstrak menyebut 'constrained geometry of the setup', bukan secara harfiah 'of a row'.

kalimat: Roy et al. built a piecewise incremental SfM for apple rows because standard SfM failed under the constrained geometry of a row [roy2016surveying], then merged counts from both sides of 252 trees with an accuracy of 91.98–94.81% [roy2019vision].
halaman: Seksi 5.1, h. 11; Seksi 5.4, h. 19; Tabel 2, h. 20
bukti: Our counting accuracy from both sides for Dataset1, Dataset3 and Dataset4 are 94.81%, 91.98%, and 94.68% respectively.
perbaikan: then merged counts from both sides of the row on three validation datasets of 22 trees in total (6, 10, and 6 trees; 958 harvested apples), with an accuracy of 91.98–94.81% against harvested counts [roy2019vision]. (The 252 trees are the three rows of the overall field trials, not the two-sided merging test.)
catatan: Rentang 91,98–94,81% benar. Angka 252 pohon adalah total tiga baris uji lapangan (abstrak, h. 1); penggabungan dua sisi hanya diuji pada Dataset1, Dataset3, dan Dataset4 (6 + 10 + 6 = 22 pohon; 270 + 274 + 414 apel). Nilai 252 pada Tabel 2 adalah jumlah buah hasil gabungan Dataset3, bukan jumlah pohon.

kalimat: Dong et al. addressed the same two-side problem by aligning the reconstructions of both sides with global and semantic features, since the two sides share little overlap [dong2020semantic].
bukti: merging the two side-views is difficult due to the lack of overlap between the two partial reconstructions. Our first main contribution in this paper is a novel method that utilizes global features and semantic information to obtain an initial solution aligning the two sides.
catatan: Sesuai. Sumber menyebut 'lack of overlap' dan 'nearly no overlap', sejalan dengan 'share little overlap'.

kalimat: Gongal et al. used 3D positions to remove apples seen from both sides, but misidentified 21.1% of duplicates [gongal2016apple].
bukti: The location of apples in three-dimensional (3D) space was used to eliminate duplicate counting of apples that were visible to cameras from both sides of the tree canopy. The error on identifying duplicate apples was found to be 21.1%.
catatan: Abstrak menulis "error on identifying duplicate apples 21.1%"; definisi galat tidak dirinci di abstrak, sehingga rumusan yang paling aman mengikuti frasa sumber.

kalimat: Gené-Molá et al. projected Mask R-CNN detections into an SfM point cloud and improved F1 from 0.816 to 0.881, at a processing cost they judged unsuitable for real time [genemola2020fruitb].
bukti: the main disadvantage is the high processing time required for SfM, which makes it presently unsuitable for real-time work.
catatan: Mask R-CNN, proyeksi deteksi 2D ke ruang 3D (SfM), F1 0,816 ke 0,881, dan tidak cocok untuk waktu nyata tertulis di abstrak. Ejaan nama penulis di sumber: Gené-Mola.

kalimat: Matos et al. combined SfM with bipartite graph matching for apples filmed with unconstrained camera motion and low frame rates [matos2024tracking].
bukti: combining Structure-from-Motion (SfM) with a bipartite graph matching has the potential to address those challenges. We found that our approach applied to real-world datasets, with unconstrained camera motion and low frame rates, outperforms existing methods
catatan: SfM, bipartite graph matching, gerak kamera bebas, dan laju bingkai rendah sesuai abstrak; apel sesuai judul.

kalimat: Lee et al. fused YOLO detections with SLAM point clouds from LiDAR in a 6 m by 70 m pear plot and reached 96.2% counting accuracy [lee2026lidarcamera].
bukti: The system estimated a total of 1,963 fruits compared with the ground truth of 1,891 fruits, yielding a net over-count of 72 fruits, corresponding to a relative counting error of 3.8% and an overall counting accuracy of 96.2%.
catatan: Sesuai: YOLOv11s digabung dengan peta titik 3D FAST-LIO2 (LiDAR), petak pir 6 m x 70 m. Akurasi 96,2% adalah galat neto (86 positif palsu, 14 terlewat).

kalimat: Nellithimaru and Kantor built object-level SLAM from stereo for grape counting (F1 0.977 against image counts) [nellithimaru2019rols].
bukti: We use images captured by a stereo camera and their 3D reconstruction to detect objects of interest [...] We achieve a F1 score of 0.977 with ground truth grape counts from images.
catatan: SLAM tingkat objek dari kamera stereo, anggur, dan F1 0,977 terhadap hitungan dari citra sesuai abstrak.

kalimat: Rapado-Rincón et al. tracked partial point clouds of tomatoes in 3D and estimated the total count with a maximum error of 5.08% [rapadorincon2023development]; they also showed that the final count of a tracker can hide false positives and false negatives that offset each other, and they introduced tracking metrics to expose them.
halaman: Abstrak, h. 1; Tabel 3, h. 10; Kesimpulan, h. 12
bukti: yielding a tracking accuracy of up to 71.47% using the HOTA metric and a low counting error of 5.06%.
perbaikan: estimated the total count with a best-case MAPE of 5.06% (reported as 5.08% in the abstract), obtained at height step 2; over the full ten-height sequence the best MAPE was 12.21%
catatan: Abstrak menulis "maximum error of 5.08%", tetapi Tabel 3, Diskusi, dan Kesimpulan memberi MAPE 5,06%, yaitu nilai terbaik (langkah tinggi 2, ambang 0,7, n_init=1), bukan galat maksimum; seluruh urutan: 12,21%-27,50%. Bagian FP/FN yang saling meniadakan dan metrik pelacakan (HOTA) sesuai (h. 12).

kalimat: Implicit representations are the latest variant: FruitNeRF trains a semantic neural radiance field from posed images and clusters the extracted fruit points [meyer2024fruitnerf], FruitNeRF++ adds instance embeddings to remove fruit-specific tuning [meyer2025fruitnerf], and Gaussian splatting was reported to count persimmons with 96% accuracy, 16% above NeRF-based counting [hong2025fruitgaussian].
bukti: we train a semantic neural radiance field. Through uniform volume sampling of the implicit Fruit Field, we obtain fruit-only point clouds. By applying cascaded clustering on the extracted point cloud, our approach achieves precise fruit count.
catatan: NeRF semantik dari citra berpose dan pengelompokan titik buah cocok dengan abstrak.

kalimat: Implicit representations are the latest variant: FruitNeRF trains a semantic neural radiance field from posed images and clusters the extracted fruit points [meyer2024fruitnerf], FruitNeRF++ adds instance embeddings to remove fruit-specific tuning [meyer2025fruitnerf], and Gaussian splatting was reported to count persimmons with 96% accuracy, 16% above NeRF-based counting [hong2025fruitgaussian].
bukti: The masks are used to encode the identity of each fruit as instance embeddings into a neural instance field. [...] which can be clustered in a fruit-agnostic manner to obtain the fruit count.
catatan: Abstrak menyatakan embedding instans dan penghapusan kebutuhan adaptasi per jenis buah; sesuai dengan kalimat naskah.

kalimat: Implicit representations are the latest variant: FruitNeRF trains a semantic neural radiance field from posed images and clusters the extracted fruit points [meyer2024fruitnerf], FruitNeRF++ adds instance embeddings to remove fruit-specific tuning [meyer2025fruitnerf], and Gaussian splatting was reported to count persimmons with 96% accuracy, 16% above NeRF-based counting [hong2025fruitgaussian].
bukti: Evaluations on real-world persimmon orchard datasets demonstrate a 96 % counting accuracy, surpassing Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)-based methods by 16 %.
catatan: Hanya bagian yang berdampingan dengan [hong2025fruitgaussian] yang dinilai; bagian FruitNeRF dan FruitNeRF++ milik kajian lain.

kalimat: These methods build on general reconstruction tools [schonberger2016structure, mildenhall2020nerf, kerbl20233d]; their evaluations are still dominated by synthetic scenes and a few real trees.
bukti: We propose a new SfM technique that improves upon the state of the art to make a further step towards this ultimate goal. The full reconstruction pipeline is released to the public as an open-source implementation.
catatan: Kajian ini dikutip hanya sebagai alat rekonstruksi umum (SfM); abstrak mendukung sebutan itu. Bagian kalimat tentang evaluasi sintetis bukan atribusi kepada kajian ini.

kalimat: These methods build on general reconstruction tools [schonberger2016structure, mildenhall2020nerf, kerbl20233d]; their evaluations are still dominated by synthetic scenes and a few real trees.
bukti: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views.
catatan: NeRF adalah metode umum representasi adegan dan sintesis pandangan; sesuai sebagai rujukan alat rekonstruksi umum. Bagian kalimat tentang evaluasi adegan sintetis dan pohon nyata tidak diatribusikan ke kajian ini.

kalimat: These methods build on general reconstruction tools [schonberger2016structure, mildenhall2020nerf, kerbl20233d]; their evaluations are still dominated by synthetic scenes and a few real trees.
bukti: starting from sparse points produced during camera calibration, we represent the scene with 3D Gaussians that preserve desirable properties of continuous volumetric radiance fields for scene optimization
catatan: Sumber adalah metode rekonstruksi/render umum (3D Gaussian Splatting), sesuai dengan sebutan alat rekonstruksi umum. Bagian kalimat tentang evaluasi adegan sintetis adalah pernyataan tinjauan, bukan klaim sumber ini.

kalimat: Foliage moves between views, which violates the static-scene assumption of standard SfM and SLAM; dynamic-scene methods exist [bescos2021dynaslam, saputra2019visual], but no included fruit study measured how much foliage motion degrades counts.
bukti: Most SLAM approaches assume a static scene and can only handle small fractions of dynamic content by labeling them as outliers to such static model
catatan: Sumber mendukung asumsi adegan statis pada SLAM dan keberadaan metode adegan dinamis (DynaSLAM II, stereo/RGB-D, diuji pada KITTI). Sumber tidak membahas dedaunan; bagian itu adalah pernyataan naskah sendiri.

kalimat: Foliage moves between views, which violates the static-scene assumption of standard SfM and SLAM; dynamic-scene methods exist [bescos2021dynaslam, saputra2019visual], but no included fruit study measured how much foliage motion degrades counts.
bukti: most SfM and visual SLAM techniques operate based on the assumption that the observed environment is static. [...] we present for the first time a survey of visual SLAM and SfM techniques that are targeted toward operation in dynamic environments.
catatan: Abstrak mendukung asumsi adegan statis dan keberadaan metode adegan dinamis. Bagian tentang gerak dedaunan adalah pernyataan naskah sendiri, bukan atribusi ke kajian ini.

kalimat: Assigning fruit to trees is a separate geometric problem; Zine-El-Abidine et al. solved it by aligning a harvest-time point cloud to a leaf-off winter cloud in which each tree's branches are visible (accuracy above 95%) [zineelabidine2021assigning].
halaman: Abstrak, h. 1; Gambar 8, h. 20; Simpulan, h. 22
bukti: Alignment of the two point clouds enables mapping apple locations to the delineated winter cloud and assigning each apple to its bearing tree. Our apple assignment method achieves an accuracy rate higher than 95%.
catatan: Teks lengkap yang tersedia adalah pracetak arXiv 2012.13721v1, bukan versi jurnal; nomor halaman mengikuti pracetak. Awan titik musim dingin tanpa daun dan penyelarasan (kalibrasi + ICP) cocok. Akurasi dihitung atas apel yang terdeteksi benar pada 7 adegan (4-5 pohon per adegan).

kalimat: Fusaro et al. segmented fruit in coloured terrestrial laser scans, extracted a descriptor per fruit with a sparse convolutional network, and matched fruit between sessions with an attention-based network and a probabilistic assignment, on strawberry and apple data [fusaro2026horticultural].
bukti: We recorded the strawberry point clouds with a terrestrial laser scanner in a greenhouse, while apple point clouds were obtained from RGB images using photogrammetric reconstruction. [...] For the re-identification experiments, we focus exclusively on the strawberry dataset
perbaikan: Fusaro et al. segmented fruit in coloured point clouds (terrestrial laser scans of strawberries and a photogrammetric apple dataset), extracted a descriptor per fruit with a sparse convolutional network, and matched fruit between sessions with an attention-based network and a probabilistic assignment; re-identification between sessions was evaluated on the strawberry data only, and the apple data were used for instance segmentation only.
catatan: Segmentasi, deskriptor sparse CNN, matcher berbasis atensi, dan penugasan probabilistik sesuai sumber. Data apel (PFuji-Size) berasal dari fotogrametri citra RGB, bukan pemindaian laser, dan hanya dipakai untuk segmentasi instans; pencocokan antarsesi hanya diuji pada stroberi.

kalimat: Isobe et al. fused features from different angles of a 360-degree mandarin video in a transformer and regressed the count, without an explicit identity for each fruit [isobe2025mandarin].
bukti: A deep neural network model leveraging Transformer architecture is designed to fuse features from various viewing angles.
catatan: Abstrak mengonfirmasi mandarin, video 360 derajat, dan fusi fitur lintas sudut dengan Transformer serta estimasi jumlah buah. Bagian "regressed the count, without an explicit identity for each fruit" tidak dinyatakan dalam abstrak dan teks lengkap tidak terjangkau; perlu diperiksa pada PDF artikel (akses terbuka).

kalimat: Zheng et al., discussed under M2, learned a distance that combines appearance and position [zheng2023object].
bukti: an improved FaceNet model was proposed to combine the image and position information to calculate the feature distance between those objects
catatan: Jarak terpelajar yang menggabungkan citra dan posisi sesuai abstrak.

kalimat: Outside agriculture, learned association is established for multi-camera tracking of people and vehicles, where datasets with identities across cameras exist [ristani2016performance, chavdarova2018wildtrack, tang2019cityflow, braso2020learning].
bukti: All trajectories were manually annotated by five people over a year, using an interface we developed to mark trajectory key points and associate identities across cameras.
catatan: Kajian ini mendukung bagian tentang tersedianya dataset dengan identitas lintas kamera untuk pelacakan orang (8 kamera, lebih dari 2.700 identitas). Sistem acuannya sendiri tidak memakai asosiasi terpelajar: korelasi dihitung dari histogram warna dan penalaran temporal sederhana (Seksi 5, h. 12). Bagian asosiasi terpelajar dan kendaraan harus ditopang oleh kutipan lain dalam kalimat itu.

kalimat: Outside agriculture, learned association is established for multi-camera tracking of people and vehicles, where datasets with identities across cameras exist [ristani2016performance, chavdarova2018wildtrack, tang2019cityflow, braso2020learning].
bukti: The annotations of the individual tracks are provided both as 3D locations on the ground plane and 2D bounding-boxes projected in each of the 7 views.
catatan: Dataset pejalan kaki tujuh kamera dengan anotasi lintasan individu yang sama di semua pandangan; teks juga melaporkan IDF1 untuk pelacakan. Sumber ini adalah dataset, bukan metode asosiasi terpelajar; kalimat naskah memakainya sebagai contoh dataset, sehingga sesuai.

kalimat: Outside agriculture, learned association is established for multi-camera tracking of people and vehicles, where datasets with identities across cameras exist [ristani2016performance, chavdarova2018wildtrack, tang2019cityflow, braso2020learning].
bukti: In total, there are 229,680 bounding boxes of 666 vehicle identities annotated, where each passes through at least 2 cameras.
catatan: CityFlow adalah benchmark MTMC kendaraan dengan identitas lintas kamera (40 kamera); baseline asosiasinya memakai fitur ReID hasil metric learning. Bagian kalimat untuk kajian ini sesuai.

kalimat: Outside agriculture, learned association is established for multi-camera tracking of people and vehicles, where datasets with identities across cameras exist [ristani2016performance, chavdarova2018wildtrack, tang2019cityflow, braso2020learning].
bukti: All experiments are done on the MOTChallenge pedestrian benchmark. [...] The challenge includes three separate tracking benchmarks, namely 2D MOT 2015 [46], MOT16 [54] and MOT17 [54].
perbaikan: Cite braso2020learning for learned data association in single-camera pedestrian tracking (MOTChallenge: 2D MOT 2015, MOT16, MOT17), not for multi-camera tracking; e.g. 'Outside agriculture, learned association is established for tracking of people and vehicles, both within a single camera [braso2020learning] and across cameras, where datasets with identities across cameras exist [ristani2016performance, chavdarova2018wildtrack, tang2019cityflow].'
catatan: Asosiasi terpelajar (message passing network) benar, tetapi kajian ini hanya menguji pelacakan pejalan kaki kamera tunggal; tidak ada eksperimen multikamera atau kendaraan. DukeMTMC hanya dipakai untuk melatih fitur ReID.

kalimat: The obstacle in fruit is the same one these datasets removed: M5 needs identity labels across views, and in the included corpus only a handful of fruit datasets provide them, among them GrapeMOTS [arizasentis2024grapemots], the tomato MOT set of [qi2025assessment], the 4D orchard set of [lei2025spatio], and SawitMVC [indriani2026sawitmvc].
bukti: The same ID was maintained for grape bunches seen from different perspectives to enhance Object Tracking.
catatan: Anotasi MOTS pada 11 video UAV; delapan video multi-sudut mempertahankan ID tandan anggur yang sama lintas perspektif.

kalimat: The obstacle in fruit is the same one these datasets removed: M5 needs identity labels across views, and in the included corpus only a handful of fruit datasets provide them, among them GrapeMOTS [arizasentis2024grapemots], the tomato MOT set of [qi2025assessment], the 4D orchard set of [lei2025spatio], and SawitMVC [indriani2026sawitmvc].
bukti: we herein establish a public multi-object tracking (MOT) dataset for tomato cluster counts, while evaluating and comparing state-of-the-art target detection and MOT-based algorithms.
catatan: Dataset MOT publik untuk tandan tomat; anotasi MOT memuat identitas lintas bingkai, dan MOTA dilaporkan.

kalimat: The obstacle in fruit is the same one these datasets removed: M5 needs identity labels across views, and in the included corpus only a handful of fruit datasets provide them, among them GrapeMOTS [arizasentis2024grapemots], the tomato MOT set of [qi2025assessment], the 4D orchard set of [lei2025spatio], and SawitMVC [indriani2026sawitmvc].
bukti: We publicly release a multimodal dataset covering five fruit species across their growth seasons
catatan: Abstrak hanya menyebut dataset multimodal lima spesies buah, tanpa menyebut label identitas. Pracetak arXiv [parafrasa web] menyatakan dataset berisi LiDAR, RGB, RGB-D, IMU, dan GPS, sedangkan pencocokan identitas dibuat manual hanya pada lima pohon untuk evaluasi; tidak ada pernyataan bahwa label identitas lintas pandang atau lintas sesi ikut dirilis. Klaim bahwa dataset ini menyediakan label identitas perlu diverifikasi pada teks terbit atau halaman dataset, atau kalimat dilunakkan.

kalimat: The obstacle in fruit is the same one these datasets removed: M5 needs identity labels across views, and in the included corpus only a handful of fruit datasets provide them, among them GrapeMOTS [arizasentis2024grapemots], the tomato MOT set of [qi2025assessment], the 4D orchard set of [lei2025spatio], and SawitMVC [indriani2026sawitmvc].
bukti: A separate per-tree JSON ground truth layer records 9823 unique bunches with their cross-view appearance links
catatan: Label identitas lintas pandang tersedia.

kalimat: Identity metrics were developed for exactly this purpose: HOTA balances detection and association accuracy [luiten2021hota], and IDF1 was designed for identities that persist across cameras [ristani2016performance].
bukti: HOTA balances both of these by being an explicit combination of a detection score DetA and an association score AssA.
catatan: Sesuai. Abstrak sumber juga menyebut lokalisasi sebagai komponen ketiga yang diseimbangkan; kalimat naskah tidak salah, hanya tidak menyebut lokalisasi.

kalimat: Identity metrics were developed for exactly this purpose: HOTA balances detection and association accuracy [luiten2021hota], and IDF1 was designed for identities that persist across cameras [ristani2016performance].
bukti: we propose two identity-based measures (ID precision and ID recall) that evaluate how well computed identities conform to true identities, while disregarding where or why mistakes occur. Our measures apply both within and across cameras.
catatan: IDF1 didefinisikan pada Persamaan 11 sebagai skor F1 dari IDP dan IDR dalam konteks pelacakan multikamera. Ukuran itu berlaku di dalam satu kamera maupun lintas kamera, bukan hanya lintas kamera.

kalimat: A count error alone cannot separate a correct count from offsetting duplicates and misses [rapadorincon2023development, wang2019mango].
bukti: A good counting performance can still hide plenty of association errors like ID switching, or false positives that counter false negatives.
catatan: Sesuai; juga dinyatakan di Pendahuluan (h. 3) dan Diskusi (h. 12).

kalimat: A count error alone cannot separate a correct count from offsetting duplicates and misses [rapadorincon2023development, wang2019mango].
bukti: Over the 110 frames assessed, the repeat fruit count was 9.7%, while the miss count was 7.1%, resulting in an over-estimate of 2.6% compared to the human assessment.
catatan: Sumber tidak menyatakan kalimat ini secara eksplisit; datanya mendukung simpulan (galat bersih 2,6% menutupi 9,9% hitung ganda dan 7,3% terlewat). Pernyataan umum itu merupakan inferensi naskah.

kalimat: MacEachern et al. detected green, red, and blue wild blueberries with YOLOv4 and predicted yield by regression from the counts [maceachern2023detection]; Ni et al. counted blueberries with R^2=0.886 against ground truth [ni2020deep]; Deng et al. released 17,955 annotated ripe and unripe blueberries in canopy images [deng2024detection]; and Shimomoto et al. predicted sweet pepper yield from average counts at two ripeness stages [shimomoto2025predicting].
bukti: Only minor differences in the accuracy of the nonlinear regression yield prediction models were detected, with YOLOv4-Small performing the best with a mean absolute error of 24.1%.
perbaikan: MacEachern et al. compared six YOLOv3 and YOLOv4 variants for detecting green, red, and blue wild blueberries (YOLOv4 best, mAP 79.79%) and fitted nonlinear regression models for yield (best MAE 24.1%, with YOLOv4-Small)
catatan: Tiga kelas dan YOLOv4 terbaik untuk deteksi sesuai abstrak. Kajian membandingkan enam jaringan, dan model hasil panen terbaik adalah YOLOv4-Small, bukan YOLOv4. Masukan regresi berupa cacahan tidak tertulis di abstrak; teks lengkap tidak terjangkau.

kalimat: MacEachern et al. detected green, red, and blue wild blueberries with YOLOv4 and predicted yield by regression from the counts [maceachern2023detection]; Ni et al. counted blueberries with R^2=0.886 against ground truth [ni2020deep]; Deng et al. released 17,955 annotated ripe and unripe blueberries in canopy images [deng2024detection]; and Shimomoto et al. predicted sweet pepper yield from average counts at two ripeness stages [shimomoto2025predicting].
bukti: A linear model was obtained between the ground truth and the detected number with a coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.886 and a root mean square error (RMSE) of 1.484.
catatan: R2 0,886 berlaku untuk gabungan empat kultivar (104 sampel cabang, jumlah beri per cabang, Mask R-CNN); jumlah terdeteksi cenderung lebih rendah daripada hitungan manual.

kalimat: MacEachern et al. detected green, red, and blue wild blueberries with YOLOv4 and predicted yield by regression from the counts [maceachern2023detection]; Ni et al. counted blueberries with R^2=0.886 against ground truth [ni2020deep]; Deng et al. released 17,955 annotated ripe and unripe blueberries in canopy images [deng2024detection]; and Shimomoto et al. predicted sweet pepper yield from average counts at two ripeness stages [shimomoto2025predicting].
bukti: presents the first publicly available dataset of blueberry canopy images with 17,955 ripe and unripe blueberries, which were captured in diverse orchard conditions
catatan: Angka 17.955, kelas matang/mentah, dan citra kanopi sesuai.

kalimat: MacEachern et al. detected green, red, and blue wild blueberries with YOLOv4 and predicted yield by regression from the counts [maceachern2023detection]; Ni et al. counted blueberries with R^2=0.886 against ground truth [ni2020deep]; Deng et al. released 17,955 annotated ripe and unripe blueberries in canopy images [deng2024detection]; and Shimomoto et al. predicted sweet pepper yield from average counts at two ripeness stages [shimomoto2025predicting].
bukti: The combination of ('1–40%', '41–80%') produced the highest prediction accuracy, with a WAPE of 21.35.
catatan: Paprika (sweet pepper); model terbaik memakai rerata jumlah buah pada dua tahap kematangan (1-40% dan 41-80%) dari enam baris tanam untuk hasil panen minggu berikutnya.

kalimat: Ogundele et al. used a class-aware ByteTrack for strawberries; counts correlated with ground truth at R^2=0.914 overall and at R^2=0.950 for ripe fruit [ogundele2025real].
bukti: The system achieved a high coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.914 [...] The system demonstrated its highest performance for Category III (ripe) strawberries, achieving an R2 of 0.950 and the lowest MAE of 2.65 fruits.
catatan: Stroberi, ByteTrack dengan modifikasi sadar-kelas, R2 total 0,914 dan R2 kelas matang 0,950 sesuai Tabel 10 (20 video rumah kaca).

kalimat: Zhou et al. reported a relative counting error of 6.7%, with 8.7% for ripe and 9.9% for unripe strawberries [zhou2024advancing].
bukti: Within prevalent tracking frameworks, our approach records a mere 6.7% relative counting error rate. Furthermore, the lowest error rates for the classes of ripe and unripe strawberries were 8.7% and 9.9%, respectively.
catatan: Ketiga angka sesuai. Abstrak menyebut 8,7% dan 9,9% sebagai galat terendah per kelas; kata "lowest" dapat ditambahkan bila diinginkan ketepatan penuh.

kalimat: Wu et al. reached an average counting accuracy of 72.49% across blue, purple, and green blueberries in video [wu2025maturity].
bukti: When combined with ByteTrack, it attained an average counting accuracy of 72.49% across blue, purple, and green maturity classes in video sequences.
catatan: Tabel 4 baris 'all': mPc 72,49% (biru 78,84%, ungu 74,38%, hijau 64,24%); angka itu rerata tiga video (69,07%, 74,94%, 73,45%).

kalimat: Viveros Escamilla et al. counted sweet peppers of four colours with 85.7% accuracy in two simulated environments [viveros2024maturity].
bukti: the DeepSORT algorithm was successfully applied for counting sweet peppers, demonstrating an accuracy level of 85.7% in two simulated environments
perbaikan: Viveros Escamilla et al. tracked sweet peppers of four colours, classified into four maturity stages, with YOLOv5 and DeepSORT; the abstract reports 85.7% counting accuracy in two simulated environments (videos assembled from 70 still greenhouse images each), whereas the results table reports MOTA of 0.88 and 0.87.
catatan: Angka 85,7% hanya muncul di abstrak; badan naskah (Tabel 6) melaporkan MOTA 0,88 dan 0,87 dan tidak pernah menyebut 85,7% maupun galat hitungan. Lingkungan simulasi berupa video dari susunan 70 foto diam, bukan lintasan kamera nyata; kualifikasi ini mengubah makna.

kalimat: Other studies classify after tracking: Hassan et al. tracked oranges with ByteTrack and classified each tracked fruit as ripe or unripe with a separate network [hassan2025orange], and Pardo-Beainy et al. assigned each tracked strawberry to one of nine size–maturity categories using metric dimensions from RGB-D and GNSS [pardobeainy2026maturity].
bukti: Then the Byte tracker is deployed to track oranges in consecutive video frames. Further, we have classified the fruits into two categories, ripe and unripe using MobileVit.
catatan: Pelacak Byte dan pengklasifikasi terpisah MobileViT sesuai. Kajian juga menguji varian tiga kelas (unripe, partially-ripe, ripe; akurasi 86,7%), yang tidak disebut di kalimat tetapi tidak mengubah makna.

kalimat: Other studies classify after tracking: Hassan et al. tracked oranges with ByteTrack and classified each tracked fruit as ripe or unripe with a separate network [hassan2025orange], and Pardo-Beainy et al. assigned each tracked strawberry to one of nine size–maturity categories using metric dimensions from RGB-D and GNSS [pardobeainy2026maturity].
bukti: fruit length and width are computed in metric space and combined with ripeness percentage to assign each strawberry to one of nine operational size–maturity categories using predefined threshold rules
perbaikan: Pardo-Beainy et al. tracked strawberries with YOLOv8-seg and BoT-SORT and assigned each fruit to one of nine size–maturity categories from metric length and width derived from RGB-D point clouds combined with a colour-based ripeness percentage; GNSS RTK was used to georeference the fruit for yield maps, not to measure dimensions.
catatan: Sembilan kategori, pelacakan (BoT-SORT), dan RGB-D sesuai abstrak. Dimensi metrik berasal dari awan titik RGB-D; GNSS RTK dipakai untuk peta hasil, bukan untuk dimensi. Kategori juga memakai persentase kematangan.

kalimat: Second, per-class errors differ from the overall error; the ripe class was counted more accurately than the others in two strawberry studies [ogundele2025real, zhou2024advancing], and in oil palm a video-based detector reached 90.56% mAP for a single class but 70.21% for several ripeness classes [junior2023video].
bukti: Category III (ripe) 0.950 2.65 3.37 11.63; Category II (semi-ripe) 0.752 2.70 3.16 16.25; Category I (unripe) 0.910 4.20 5.07 9.62; Total (overall) 0.914 8.55 9.63 9.52
perbaikan: the ripe class had the highest R^2 and lowest MAE (R^2=0.950, MAE 2.65 fruits), although its MAPE (11.63%) was higher than that of the unripe class (9.62%) and its RMSE (3.37) higher than that of the semi-ripe class (3.16) [ogundele2025real]
catatan: Kelas matang unggul pada R2 dan MAE, tetapi tidak pada MAPE (kelas mentah lebih rendah) dan RMSE (kelas setengah matang lebih rendah). Pernyataan 'lebih akurat daripada kelas lain' perlu dibatasi pada R2 dan MAE.

kalimat: Second, per-class errors differ from the overall error; the ripe class was counted more accurately than the others in two strawberry studies [ogundele2025real, zhou2024advancing], and in oil palm a video-based detector reached 90.56% mAP for a single class but 70.21% for several ripeness classes [junior2023video].
bukti: Furthermore, the lowest error rates for the classes of ripe and unripe strawberries were 8.7% and 9.9%, respectively.
catatan: Galat kelas matang (8,7%) lebih rendah daripada kelas mentah (9,9%) dan keduanya berbeda dari galat keseluruhan (6,7%). Perbandingan hanya memakai galat terendah tiap kelas; rincian per pelacak tidak ada di abstrak.

kalimat: Second, per-class errors differ from the overall error; the ripe class was counted more accurately than the others in two strawberry studies [ogundele2025real, zhou2024advancing], and in oil palm a video-based detector reached 90.56% mAP for a single class but 70.21% for several ripeness classes [junior2023video].
bukti: YOLOv4-Tiny 3L is the most suitable architecture for use in real time object detection conditions with an mAP of 90.56% for single class category detection and 70.21% for multi class category detection
catatan: Kedua angka cocok. Abstrak menulis 'multi class category'; bahwa kelasnya adalah kelas kematangan hanya tersirat dari judul. Angka berlaku untuk YOLOv4-Tiny 3L.

kalimat: Depth was used to remove background: Fu et al. filtered objects farther than 1.2 m from a Kinect V2 in a dense fruiting-wall orchard before detection [fu2020faster].
bukti: An outdoor machine vision system was developed with a low-cost Kinect V2 sensor to improve the accuracy of apple detection by filtering the background objects using depth features. [...] A depth threshold of 1.2 m was used to remove background.
catatan: Sensor Kinect V2, ambang 1,2 m, dan kebun fruiting-wall berkanopi rapat sesuai abstrak.

kalimat: It was fused with colour inside the detector: Tu et al. trained separate colour and depth detectors for passion fruit and fused them late, raising F1 from 0.885 for a standard Faster R-CNN on RGB-D images to 0.946 [tu2020passion], and Kaukab et al. filled depth holes before fusion because outdoor depth images are of low quality [kaukab2024improving].
bukti: Compared with the faster R-CNN detector of RGB-D images, the recall, the precision and F1-score of MS-FRCNN method increased from 0.922 to 0.962, 0.850 to 0.931 and 0.885 to 0.946, respectively.
catatan: Detektor RGB dan depth dilatih terpisah lalu digabung dengan late fusion; angka F1 0,885 dan 0,946 cocok.

kalimat: It was fused with colour inside the detector: Tu et al. trained separate colour and depth detectors for passion fruit and fused them late, raising F1 from 0.885 for a standard Faster R-CNN on RGB-D images to 0.946 [tu2020passion], and Kaukab et al. filled depth holes before fusion because outdoor depth images are of low quality [kaukab2024improving].
bukti: However, outdoor depth images are usually of low quality [...] The NBR-DF method serves as a pipeline to pre-process multi-modal data to enhance features of depth images by filling holes to eliminate noise generated by depth holes.
catatan: Pengisian lubang kedalaman dilakukan pada tahap praproses sebelum fusi berbasis atensi di YOLOv5; tanaman apel; AP 0,964.

kalimat: It gave metric size: Wang et al. estimated on-tree mango dimensions from RGB-D with RMSEs of about 4–5 mm but noted that the camera could not be used in direct intense sunshine [wang2017tree], and Neupane et al. compared eight depth cameras against a 20 mm bias-corrected RMSE requirement for fruit localization and sizing [neupane2021evaluation].
bukti: A Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) = 4.9 and 4.3 mm was achieved for estimated fruit length and width, respectively [...] but cannot be used in direct intense sunshine.
catatan: RMSE 4,9 mm (panjang) dan 4,3 mm (lebar) sesuai dengan 'about 4-5 mm'; batasan sinar matahari langsung dinyatakan di abstrak.

kalimat: It gave metric size: Wang et al. estimated on-tree mango dimensions from RGB-D with RMSEs of about 4–5 mm but noted that the camera could not be used in direct intense sunshine [wang2017tree], and Neupane et al. compared eight depth cameras against a 20 mm bias-corrected RMSE requirement for fruit localization and sizing [neupane2021evaluation].
bukti: Eight depth cameras varying in operational principle [...] were compared in context of use for in-orchard fruit localization and sizing. For this application, a specification on bias-corrected root mean square error of 20 mm for a camera-to-fruit distance of 2 m
catatan: Delapan kamera dan spesifikasi RMSE terkoreksi bias 20 mm sesuai; spesifikasi berlaku pada jarak kamera-buah 2 m dan kondisi sinar matahari, kualifikasi itu tidak disebut di naskah tetapi tidak mengubah makna.

kalimat: LiDAR detected apples by reflectance with F1 0.858 [genemola2019fruit], and LiDAR–camera fusion reduced localization error to one fifth of that of a RealSense D455 [kang2022accurate].
bukti: a localization success of 87.5%, an identification success of 82.4%, and an F1-score of 0.858 were obtained in relation to the total amount of fruits.
catatan: F1 0,858 dan deteksi apel Fuji berbasis reflektansi LiDAR (Velodyne VLP-16, 905 nm) sesuai abstrak.

kalimat: LiDAR detected apples by reflectance with F1 0.858 [genemola2019fruit], and LiDAR–camera fusion reduced localization error to one fifth of that of a RealSense D455 [kang2022accurate].
bukti: the standard deviations of fruit localisation by using LiDAR-camera at 0.5 m, 1.2 m, and 1.8 m are 0.245, 0.227, and 0.275 cm respectively. These measurement error is only one one fifth of that from Realsense D455.
catatan: Abstrak menyatakan galat pengukuran seperlima dari RealSense D455; galat itu diukur sebagai simpangan baku pelokalan buah apel. Berkas teks/kang2022accurate.txt dan PDF-nya adalah makalah yang salah dan perlu diganti.

kalimat: Active thermal imaging with water mist separated immature citrus from leaves of similar colour and supported tracking-based counting in video [gan2020active].
bukti: a thermal camera was combined with a water spray system that applied water mist to citrus trees. The water mist caused temperatures of both the fruit and leaf surfaces to change but at different rates.
catatan: Abstrak juga menyebut algoritma pelacakan dan pencacahan pada video termal (mAP 87,2%, akurasi hitungan 96%) serta masalah kemiripan warna buah muda dan daun.

kalimat: Zheng et al. filtered detections by depth and fused robot odometry before inter-frame prediction for tomatoes, reaching MOTA 0.954 against YOLOv8 with DeepSORT [zheng2025robust].
bukti: depth filtering is applied post-detection to eliminate tomato targets exceeding a predefined depth threshold ... The remaining detection boxes are then fed into the inter-frame prediction algorithm for robust multi-object tracking.
catatan: MOTA 0,954 sesuai abstrak dan teks (h. 14); itu nilai Ridge 3, sedangkan Ridge 1 dan 2 bernilai 0,980 dan 0,952. Bila angka pembanding ditambahkan: sumber tidak konsisten untuk YOLOv8+DeepSORT, yaitu 0,582 di teks (Ridge 1) dan 0,569 di Tabel 3 (rerata). Odometri berasal dari IMU dan tag RFID.

kalimat: Abeyrathna et al. obtained 3D coordinates of each tracked apple from a RealSense D455 at three vehicle speeds and three camera angles [abeyrathna2023recognition].
bukti: The 3D camera was placed at three different angles
catatan: Realsense D455, koordinat 3D tiap apel yang dilacak (Deep SORT), tiga kecepatan (0,052; 0,069; 0,098 m/s) dan tiga sudut kamera (tegak lurus, 15 derajat, 30 derajat) sesuai. Apel dipasang pada pohon buatan di lapangan; naskah tidak menyebut hal ini tetapi klaimnya tidak keliru.

kalimat: Felip-Pomés et al. found that the Azure Kinect gave more consistent results than the ZED 2 across dates in a 420-tree orchard [felippomes2026video].
bukti: Comparing the two evaluated sensors, Azure Kinect provided more consistent performance across different dates.
catatan: Kebun percobaan berisi 420 pohon apel sesuai abstrak.

kalimat: Liu et al. used depth relative to the trunk to resolve two-side duplicates [liu2019monocular].
bukti: We approach this double counting problem by using the tree centroid, which is represented by the tree trunk, to separate the tree into two parts. We then only count the fruits that lie on the closer side of the tree trunk.
catatan: Kedalaman berasal dari triangulasi SfM monokular (skala relatif), bukan dari sensor depth.

kalimat: Monocular depth networks now offer depth without a depth sensor [yang2024depthb, ranftl2021vision], and one included study used such a network with amodal masks to measure apple diameter [tan2025apple], but none used predicted depth for cross-view association with a counted reference.
bukti: This work presents Depth Anything V2. Without pursuing fancy techniques, we aim to reveal crucial findings to pave the way towards building a powerful monocular depth estimation model.
catatan: Depth Anything V2 (NeurIPS 2024) adalah model estimasi kedalaman monokular; kedalaman diprediksi dari satu citra RGB tanpa sensor kedalaman.

kalimat: Monocular depth networks now offer depth without a depth sensor [yang2024depthb, ranftl2021vision], and one included study used such a network with amodal masks to measure apple diameter [tan2025apple], but none used predicted depth for cross-view association with a counted reference.
bukti: For monocular depth estimation, we observe an improvement of up to 28% in relative performance when compared to a state-of-the-art fully-convolutional network.
catatan: DPT adalah jaringan estimasi kedalaman monokular dari citra RGB tunggal; mendukung pernyataan umum kedalaman tanpa sensor kedalaman.

kalimat: Monocular depth networks now offer depth without a depth sensor [yang2024depthb, ranftl2021vision], and one included study used such a network with amodal masks to measure apple diameter [tan2025apple], but none used predicted depth for cross-view association with a counted reference.
bukti: We propose a framework that integrates the Occlusion-aware Mask R-CNN for apple detection, amodal segmentation, and diameter estimation from mask geometry with the Depth Anything V2 model for monocular metric depth estimation.
catatan: Abstrak menyebut jaringan kedalaman monokular (Depth Anything V2) digabung dengan masker amodal untuk mengukur diameter apel; MAE sekitar 7,72 mm. Bagian 'none used predicted depth for cross-view association' adalah pernyataan tinjauan, bukan klaim kajian ini.

kalimat: Early work extracted colour features and classified them with neural networks or support vector machines [fadilah2012oil, sabri2018evaluation], followed by colour and texture features with classical classifiers [septiarini2021machine] and by convolutional networks deployed on mobile devices [suharjito2021oil].
bukti: Then the color features were extracted from those images. These features were used as the input parameters for ANN learning.
catatan: Fitur warna dan jaringan saraf tiruan sesuai; 80 sampel TBS, empat kategori kematangan.

kalimat: Early work extracted colour features and classified them with neural networks or support vector machines [fadilah2012oil, sabri2018evaluation], followed by colour and texture features with classical classifiers [septiarini2021machine] and by convolutional networks deployed on mobile devices [suharjito2021oil].
bukti: This paper investigates the application of eight color models for automatic palm oil Fresh Fruit Bunch (FFB) ripeness classification with multi-class Support Vector Machine (SVM). [...] Color moments were extracted from each of these color models
catatan: Kajian ini memakai fitur warna (color moment) dan SVM multikelas; bagian 'neural networks' pada kalimat merujuk kajian lain yang disitasi bersama.

kalimat: Early work extracted colour features and classified them with neural networks or support vector machines [fadilah2012oil, sabri2018evaluation], followed by colour and texture features with classical classifiers [septiarini2021machine] and by convolutional networks deployed on mobile devices [suharjito2021oil].
bukti: The process of feature extraction was applied based on the colour and texture followed by feature selection using principal component analysis (PCA) [...] Subsequently, an artificial neural network (ANN) with a back-propagation algorithm was applied in the classification process
perbaikan: followed by colour and texture features selected with PCA and classified with a back-propagation artificial neural network [septiarini2021machine]
catatan: Fitur warna dan tekstur pada TBS sawit benar. Pengklasifikasinya ANN propagasi balik; sebutan 'classical classifiers' kurang tepat dan mengaburkan beda dengan kalimat sebelumnya yang menyebut 'neural networks'.

kalimat: Early work extracted colour features and classified them with neural networks or support vector machines [fadilah2012oil, sabri2018evaluation], followed by colour and texture features with classical classifiers [septiarini2021machine] and by convolutional networks deployed on mobile devices [suharjito2021oil].
bukti: [parafrasa web] TLDR Semantic Scholar: the best model is EfficientNetB0, trained with transfer learning, 9 angle crop, and float16 quantization, achieving an overall test accuracy of 0.893 on TensorFlow Lite; second-best MobileNetV1 with 0.811.
catatan: Judul dan TLDR menyatakan klasifikasi kematangan TBS dengan jaringan konvolusi (EfficientNetB0, MobileNetV1) pada TensorFlow Lite untuk perangkat seluler. Teks lengkap tidak terakses.

kalimat: The largest study in the corpus trained on 10,000 photographs from five Indonesian plantation sites in four classes and reported 96.54% accuracy on locations not seen in training [usman2026integration].
halaman: Tabel 12, h. 16-17; abstrak, h. 1; Tabel 5, h. 6
bukti: The Leave-Site-Out 5-fold cross-validation demonstrates the model's generalization ability on unseen geographical sites in a rigorous manner, producing accuracies of between 93.73% and 95.14% (mean: 94.66% ± 0.54%
perbaikan: Replace 96.54% with 94.66% (± 0.54%, Leave-Site-Out 5-fold cross-validation). Suggested wording: "used 10,000 photographs (8,000 for training) from five Indonesian plantation sites in four classes and reported 94.66% ± 0.54% accuracy under leave-site-out cross-validation on sites not seen in training".
catatan: Angka 96,54% tidak ada di sumber; tampaknya gabungan keliru dari 94,66% dan ± 0,54%. Bagian 10.000 foto, lima lokasi, dan empat kelas sesuai abstrak, tetapi data latih hanya 8.000 dari 10.000 citra (Tabel 5). Sumber juga tidak konsisten: Tabel 3 menyebut 3 perkebunan (7.000 citra lapangan) ditambah 3.000 citra Roboflow. Klaim 'the largest study in the corpus' adalah pernyataan tinjauan, tidak diperiksa di sini.

kalimat: Reviews of this work agree that computer vision with deep learning is the most feasible field method [lai2023oil] and that fusion with LiDAR may add localization [goh2025fresh].
bukti: it was found that the most feasible method for detecting ripe FFBs in the field is a combination of computer vision and deep learning.
catatan: Seksi 3.4 merinci: colour vision sensing dengan CNN classifier.

kalimat: Reviews of this work agree that computer vision with deep learning is the most feasible field method [lai2023oil] and that fusion with LiDAR may add localization [goh2025fresh].
bukti: A compelling solution emerges in the fusion of light detection and ranging and computer vision techniques. [...] Furthermore, this fusion yields added value in terms of localization and mapping
catatan: Fusi LiDAR dengan visi komputer dan nilai tambah lokalisasi dinyatakan di abstrak dan seksi Challenges and Future Prospects.

kalimat: Non-RGB sensing has been tested with thermal imaging [zolfagharnassab2022classification], hyperspectral imaging [bensaeed2014oil], laser-light backscattering [mohd2020combination], LiDAR [husin2021distribution], and radar with bunch mass [resta2026multimodal], several of them on harvested bunches.
bukti: FFBs samples were harvested from the plantation and kept at room temperature overnight prior to being scanned by the thermal camera.
catatan: Pencitraan termal (FLIR E60) dilakukan pada tandan yang sudah dipanen; sesuai dengan keterangan "on harvested bunches".

kalimat: Non-RGB sensing has been tested with thermal imaging [zolfagharnassab2022classification], hyperspectral imaging [bensaeed2014oil], laser-light backscattering [mohd2020combination], LiDAR [husin2021distribution], and radar with bunch mass [resta2026multimodal], several of them on harvested bunches.
halaman: abstrak, h. 2; Seksi 2.2 dan Gambar 6, h. 10
bukti: a hyperspectral-based system was introduced to detect the ripeness of oil palm fresh fruit bunches (FFB). The FFBs were scanned using a hyperspectral device, and reflectance was recorded at different wavelengths.
catatan: Pencitraan hiperspektral 400-1000 nm pada tandan yang sudah dipanen (di atas konveyor/x-stage, dalam ruang); sesuai, termasuk keterangan 'on harvested bunches'.

kalimat: Non-RGB sensing has been tested with thermal imaging [zolfagharnassab2022classification], hyperspectral imaging [bensaeed2014oil], laser-light backscattering [mohd2020combination], LiDAR [husin2021distribution], and radar with bunch mass [resta2026multimodal], several of them on harvested bunches.
bukti: This study evaluated the utilization of combined computer vision and laser-light backscattering imaging in determining the oil content and color changes of oil palm FFB at different maturity levels i.e. unripe, ripe, and overripe.
catatan: Laser-light backscattering pada 90 sampel TBS sesuai abstrak. Abstrak tidak menyebut secara eksplisit bahwa tandan sudah dipanen; pengukuran kadar minyak acuan mengisyaratkan demikian.

kalimat: Non-RGB sensing has been tested with thermal imaging [zolfagharnassab2022classification], hyperspectral imaging [bensaeed2014oil], laser-light backscattering [mohd2020combination], LiDAR [husin2021distribution], and radar with bunch mass [resta2026multimodal], several of them on harvested bunches.
