bukti: This research objective is to categorize the ripeness of oil palm FFB from data received from the sensor and to create a distribution map.
catatan: LiDAR tertulis di judul dan abstrak. Abstrak tidak melaporkan hasil kuantitatif dan tidak menyebut apakah tandan masih di pohon atau sudah dipanen.

kalimat: Non-RGB sensing has been tested with thermal imaging [zolfagharnassab2022classification], hyperspectral imaging [bensaeed2014oil], laser-light backscattering [mohd2020combination], LiDAR [husin2021distribution], and radar with bunch mass [resta2026multimodal], several of them on harvested bunches.
bukti: A continuous wave 2.4 GHz radar and a digital scale capture backscattered power and bunch mass as internal cues related to dielectric properties and growth, while RGB images provide external color and texture information.
catatan: Radar 2,4 GHz dan massa tandan sesuai; data diambil di loading ramp komersial, jadi tandan sudah dipanen.

kalimat: Lai et al. trained YOLOv4 on images from a RealSense D435 with expert labels for ripe and unripe bunches [lai2022real], Mansour et al. compared detectors on four ripeness classes [mansour2022object], Junos et al. detected bunches, grabbers, and palms in plantation scenes and bunches in UAV images [junos2021optimized, junos2022automatic], and Zaman et al. addressed occlusion by fronds in UAV images [zaman2025hybrid].
bukti: To train the YOLOv4 model, a large number of ripe FFB images were collected using an Intel Realsense Camera D435 [...] During data acquisition, a subject matter expert assisted in classifying the FFBs in terms of ripe or unripe.
catatan: YOLOv4, RealSense D435, dan pelabelan matang/mentah oleh pakar sesuai abstrak. Detektor ditujukan untuk tandan matang.

kalimat: Lai et al. trained YOLOv4 on images from a RealSense D435 with expert labels for ripe and unripe bunches [lai2022real], Mansour et al. compared detectors on four ripeness classes [mansour2022object], Junos et al. detected bunches, grabbers, and palms in plantation scenes and bunches in UAV images [junos2021optimized, junos2022automatic], and Zaman et al. addressed occlusion by fronds in UAV images [zaman2025hybrid].
bukti: MobileNetV2 SSD, EfficientDet (Lite0, Lite1 and Lite2) and YOLOv5 (YOLOv5n, YOLOv5s and YOLOv5m) were simulated and compared [...] The models were trained on a dataset with four main ripeness classes: ripe, unripe, half-ripe, and over-ripe.
catatan: Perbandingan beberapa detektor pada empat kelas kematangan sesuai abstrak.

kalimat: Lai et al. trained YOLOv4 on images from a RealSense D435 with expert labels for ripe and unripe bunches [lai2022real], Mansour et al. compared detectors on four ripeness classes [mansour2022object], Junos et al. detected bunches, grabbers, and palms in plantation scenes and bunches in UAV images [junos2021optimized, junos2022automatic], and Zaman et al. addressed occlusion by fronds in UAV images [zaman2025hybrid].
bukti: an optimized YOLOv3 tiny network namely YOLO-P is proposed to detect and localize three objects at palm oil plantation which include fresh fruit bunch, grabber and palm tree under various environment conditions.
catatan: Bagian yang dinilai hanya "bunches, grabbers, and palms in plantation scenes"; bagian citra UAV milik junos2022automatic. Teks lengkap tidak terjangkau, penilaian dari abstrak.

kalimat: Lai et al. trained YOLOv4 on images from a RealSense D435 with expert labels for ripe and unripe bunches [lai2022real], Mansour et al. compared detectors on four ripeness classes [mansour2022object], Junos et al. detected bunches, grabbers, and palms in plantation scenes and bunches in UAV images [junos2021optimized, junos2022automatic], and Zaman et al. addressed occlusion by fronds in UAV images [zaman2025hybrid].
bukti: This paper proposed an improved YOLO model to detect oil palm loose fruits from unmanned aerial vehicle images.
perbaikan: ... and loose fruits in UAV images [junos2022automatic] (the study detects oil palm loose fruits, not bunches; AP 99.76%, 34.06 ms)
catatan: Objek yang dideteksi adalah brondolan (loose fruits), bukan tandan. Citra UAV sesuai.

kalimat: Lai et al. trained YOLOv4 on images from a RealSense D435 with expert labels for ripe and unripe bunches [lai2022real], Mansour et al. compared detectors on four ripeness classes [mansour2022object], Junos et al. detected bunches, grabbers, and palms in plantation scenes and bunches in UAV images [junos2021optimized, junos2022automatic], and Zaman et al. addressed occlusion by fronds in UAV images [zaman2025hybrid].
bukti: A key issue in detecting Fresh Fruit Bunches (FFB) in UAV imagery is occlusion, caused by overlapping fronds, clustered bunches, and inconsistent viewing angles, which often leads to undetected or misclassified objects.
catatan: Abstrak menyebut oklusi oleh pelepah pada citra UAV, ditangani dengan Loss Rank Mining pada YOLOv11. Oklusi juga disebabkan tandan yang bergerombol dan sudut pandang, tetapi kalimat naskah tidak keliru.

kalimat: Goh et al. released 400 plantation images with registered depth maps and point clouds from a RealSense D455f for ripeness classification and localization [goh2025outdoor], the only oil-palm RGB-D dataset in the corpus.
bukti: The dataset includes 400 high-resolution RGB images captured with a 50 MP Sony IMX766V sensor, along with 400 depth maps and corresponding point clouds obtained using an Intel RealSense D455f camera.

catatan: Sesuai. Catatan: FFB dicacah saat panen melalui pelacakan grabber (Faster R-CNN) sampai tumpang-tindih dengan lokasi FFB, sedangkan brondolan dideteksi dengan pengolahan citra sebelum panen.

kalimat: Naftali et al. and Hamdani et al. built plantation datasets with partial visibility, occlusion, and density levels [naftali2024palm, hamdani2026automated], and Hidayat et al. proposed a standard procedure for capturing bunch images in the plantation [hidayat2024establishing].

catatan: Dataset perkebunan dengan tingkat kepadatan (rendah, sedang, tinggi) sesuai; oklusi disebut sebagai kondisi lapangan. 'Partial visibility' tidak disebut di abstrak kajian ini dan diperlakukan sebagai atribusi ke naftali2024palm.

kalimat: Suharjito et al. recorded unharvested palms from multiple angles with a smartphone for a digital census and released 14,503 images in five maturity classes, but the annotations are per image [suharjito2025oil].
bukti: The data collection process entailed recording videos by rotating around each tree to capture all fruit images from multiple angles. [...] Bounding boxes were drawn around each fruit and oil palm flower in the images.
catatan: 14.503 citra (10.207 + 2.896 + 1.400) dan lima kelas cocok. Dua catatan: (1) jumlah 14.503 adalah jumlah setelah augmentasi (h. 3), bukan bingkai asli; (2) dua dari lima kelas adalah Flower dan Abnormal. Anotasi berupa kotak pembatas per bingkai format COCO; sumber tidak menyebut identitas tandan lintas bingkai, sehingga "per image" sesuai tetapi tidak dinyatakan eksplisit.

catatan: Abstrak mendukung keberadaan tautan identitas lintas pandang; kata 'only' adalah klaim tentang korpus tinjauan, bukan tentang sumber ini.

kalimat: Warni et al. combined stereo detection with Hungarian matching to localize loose fruit in 3D [warni2026stereo], which is an association step, but for a stereo pair, not for views around a palm.
bukti: [parafrasa web] Hungarian Matching ensures that detected bounding boxes in the left image are accurately associated with their corresponding detections in the right image; 3D coordinates follow from stereo triangulation of loose oil palm fruits detected by YOLOv8.
catatan: Pencocokan Hungarian dipakai antara citra kiri dan kanan pasangan stereo, bukan antarsisi pohon; sesuai dengan kalimat naskah. Nomor halaman tidak diperiksa karena sumber berupa halaman web.

kalimat: Tree-level counting from UAV images has addressed re-counting errors for palms themselves [pragatheesh2025deep, kipli2023deep], not for bunches.

catatan: Objek yang dihitung adalah pohon sawit, bukan tandan; data berupa video UAV dengan bingkai yang tumpang-tindih.

kalimat: Tree-level counting from UAV images has addressed re-counting errors for palms themselves [pragatheesh2025deep, kipli2023deep], not for bunches.

halaman: Seksi IV, h. 3; Seksi II, h. 2
bukti: The first results from observing the same fruit across consecutive images [...] The second is double tracking caused by the re-observation of a previously tracked fruit. The third is double counting of fruits visible from two opposite views of the tree
catatan: Tiga sumber hitung ganda sesuai; makalah merumuskannya untuk dua urutan citra dari dua sisi baris pohon.

bukti: Liu et al. [36] summarized three major issues causing over counting in video based fruit yield estimation—(1) double count of the same fruit detected in consecutive frames; (2) double count of a fruit which is tracked across several frames, not detected in a frame
catatan: Dinilai dengan anggapan bahwa "three sources" adalah tiga sumber hitung ganda dari Liu dkk. Wang dkk. mengutip ketiganya dan menambah kategori keempat (salah penugasan buah baru ke buah lama).
